title: Pressure
content: Pressure is defined as the force exerted normally on unit area[cite: 1].

title: Density
content: Density is the ratio of mass to volume of a substance[cite: 1].

title: Relative Density
content: Relative density is the ratio of the density of a substance to the density of water at 4 degrees Celsius[cite: 1].

title: Hydrometer
content: Hydrometer is an instrument for measuring the density or relative density of liquids[cite: 1].
